hooks.command: filepath="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$filepath" == *.css ]]; then npx stylelint --fix "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; elif [[ "$filepath" == *.js ]]; then npx eslint --fix "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; fi
filepath="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$filepath" in */dist/*|*/.mcp.json|*/package-lock.json) echo 'BLOCK: This file is generated or sensitive — do not edit directly.' >&2; exit 2;; esac
